review_candidates.description: Job Title: Support & Operations Engineer Duration: 18+ Months (Contract to Hire) Location: Blue Ash, OH Onsite Pay Rate: $60-70/hr only on w2 Top 3 skills Major Incident Management experience — has actually run or driven a bridge/war-room for a P1/P2 outage, not just "participated." RCA/Problem Management rigor — can articulate a structured RCA methodology (5-whys, fishbone, timeline reconstruction) and, more importantly, examples where they drove a corrective action to closure (not just wrote a doc that nobody actioned). Production troubleshooting under pressure across a mixed stack — comfortable reading logs/dashboards (Dynatrace-type tooling) and reasoning about cloud + on-prem + store/POS systems simultaneously, since a real incident here will span all three. Additional Information · Site Reliability Engineers will be successful but must understand this is a support role · Still lots of engineering involved, will be working in the code every day · Looking for a solid and motivated technologist · Candidate does not need to tick all skills boxes, but does need to be able to be onsite and travel Are there any automatic disqualifiers? · No on-call/off-hours availability · Pure DevOps/CI-CD background with zero incident-response exposure Travel Expectations · Lots of flexibility, it will ebb and flow with needs · Currently more local travel (Cincy and Louisville Stores) but as new sites go live, travel will expand · Will be traveling every 4 weeks or so · Travel and on call is split between 6 people - and expecting team to grow On Call/ Off Hours Expectations · Split between 6 people and rotates weekly · Team is currently splitting 2 shifts a day · Periodic off hours during go lives · This team is an escalation point - they are not fielding everything · There is flexibility and team makes sure to balance personal lives · Overtime is not a requirement - if working outside of working hours, candidates can take time off during business hours to balance time out- HM can clarify if candidate is offered Work location · In office 5-days a week at BTC location to work in lab - Must be local to Cincy area · Might be relaxed on onsite later down line once travel picks up Pre-screening Details · Automated pre-screening Interview process details · First round: HM · Second round: Team Interview Additional Information 1. Hands-on vs. office-based : This is a Level 3 Support Engineer role within the NGPOS engineering organization, supporting the software and infrastructure behind the POS platform. There is a hands-on hardware component when working in our engineering lab or onsite supporting stores, but the core of the role is software/systems support, not hardware development. 2. Support vs. engineering split : This is not a developer role. Prior development experience is not required, though it can be an asset when troubleshooting complex issues. We've had both developers and non-developers be very successful in this position. 3. Travel : Today, store locations are local, Milford, OH and Scottsburg, IN. However, we're scaling this rollout from 2 stores to over 2,700 stores nationwide over the next two years, so travel will expand well beyond local sites as that rollout progresses. Candidates should currently expect roughly 50% travel, which will vary based on rollout timelines, pilot launches, and system stability.
